headline: China Links US Agricultural Imports to Reciprocal Tariff Reductions
summary: China has tied future expansions of US agricultural product imports to reciprocal tariff reductions by Washington, according to trade reports.
why: US-China agricultural trade commitments drive global commodity prices for grains, soybeans, and agricultural equity indices.
